sentences.en: Juha walked at night and was afraid.
He got into a hole in the road and slept.

sentences.ar: אנשים עברו ושאלו: מה אתה עושה פה?
sentences.en: People passed and asked: what are you doing here?
They said: and does a dead man talk?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: מדבר אם הוא רעב.
sentences.en: He said: he talks if he is hungry.
